svg.title: A799 · Where should frozen inputs live?

g.text: A799 · Where should frozen inputs live?
Oldest + previous agreed · store proposed
B · Agreed: oldest + previous
A799 · Design review
Before publishing imagined candidate R5
Required checks from frozen inputs
R1 to R5 and R4 to R5
Keep every original bundle and expectation
R2 and R3 are not checked in this gate
No passing result is implied for them
The answer selects required checks only. It does not retire intermediate releases. Source A remains an invented venue written by the old product.
Owner chose oldest + previous
C · Recommended: separate artifact store
A799 · Design review
Git keeps a checksum index
Keep frozen bundles and expectations
In a dedicated release-artifact store
R5 fetches R1 and R4 by pinned hashes
R2 and R3 remain kept
Original sealed inputs, disposable test copies
Never rebuild history with candidate R5
Proposed contract: no in-place replacement and no upload/delete credentials for untrusted candidate code. Missing or corrupt required input blocks the run; no skip or
current-seed fallback. Provider and access are not chosen.
Proposed · not agreed
C · Alternative: keep the bundles in Git
A799 · Design review
One checkout contains source and test inputs
Commit every original bundle and expectation
Alongside the checksum index
Required upgrade checks stay R1 and R4
All four originals remain in history
Binary bundles add to Git history
The same frozen-fact comparisons apply
Choose storage only. Neither option approves capture, migration, resets, credentials or paid services. Issued F1, capture IDs/time, support and full design/build
remain open.
Proposed · not agreed
Static review drawings. R1–R5 are imagined releases after the separately authorised A760 reset. No fixture or upgrade result is established. Store, access, support/retirement, issued F1,
capture time/IDs and full design/build remain open.
